#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# Stock Analysis Visualizations in R
# Creates distribution charts and top stocks bar chart


# ============================================================================
# COMPREHENSIVE UNIVERSE STOCK SCREENER & VISUALIZATION DASHBOARD
# Designed for weekly updates in Quarto (.qmd)
# ============================================================================

# --- 1. LOAD LIBRARIES -------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)

# --- 2. LOAD & CLEAN DATA ----------------------------------------------------
universe <- read_csv("data/Universe.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Coerce key columns to numeric
num_cols <- c("RS Rating", "RS 3-Month Rating", "RS 6-Month Rating", "Comp Rating",
              "EPS Rating", "Price vs 10-Day", "Price vs 21-Day", "Price vs 50-Day",
              "Price vs 150-Day", "Price vs 200-Day", "% Off High",
              "% Chg 1 Month", "% Chg 3 Months", "% Chg 6 Months", "% Chg YTD", "% Chg 12 Months",
              "EPS % Chg Last Qtr", "EPS % Chg Lst Yr", "Avg EPS % Chg 3Q", "Avg EPS % Chg 6Q",
              "Sales % Chg Lst Qtr", "Avg Sales % Chg 3Q", "Avg Sales % Chg 6Q",
              "EPS Est Cur Yr %", "EPS Est Next Yr %", "EPS Surprise",
              "P/E", "Forward P/E", "PEG", "Price to Sales", "Price to Book",
              "Market Cap (mil)", "Volume (1000s)", "50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)",
              "Debt %", "Current Ratio", "ROE", "Beta",
              "Ind Group Rank", "Ind Grp Rnk 3 Mo Ago", "Ind Grp Rnk 6 Mo Ago",
              "Up/Down Vol", "Funds %", "Number of Funds",
              "52-Wk High", "52-Wk Low", "Current Price",
              "50 Day ATR %", "21 Day ATR %", "Daily Closing Range", "Weekly Closing Range")

universe <- universe %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(num_cols), ~as.numeric(as.character(.))))

# Separate stocks from ETFs
stocks <- universe %>% filter(Sector != "ETF/ETN/CEF", !is.na(Sector))
etfs   <- universe %>% filter(Sector == "ETF/ETN/CEF")

report_date <- unique(universe$timestamp)[1]

# --- 3. SECTOR ANALYSIS ------------------------------------------------------
sector_perf <- stocks %>%
  group_by(Sector) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Avg_RS = mean(`RS Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_RS3M = mean(`RS 3-Month Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_RS6M = mean(`RS 6-Month Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Comp = mean(`Comp Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_1M = mean(`% Chg 1 Month`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_3M = mean(`% Chg 3 Months`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_6M = mean(`% Chg 6 Months`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_YTD = mean(`% Chg YTD`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_12M = mean(`% Chg 12 Months`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_EPS_Q = mean(`EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Sales_Q = mean(`Sales % Chg Lst Qtr`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_vs50D = mean(`Price vs 50-Day`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_vs200D = mean(`Price vs 200-Day`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Above_50SMA = mean(`Price vs 50-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Pct_Above_200SMA = mean(`Price vs 200-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Pct_RS80 = mean(`RS Rating` >= 80, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Theme_Strength = case_when(
      Avg_RS3M >= 65 & Avg_YTD > 10 ~ "🔥 Leading",
      Avg_RS3M >= 55 ~ "⚡ Strong",
      Avg_RS3M >= 45 ~ "🟡 Improving",
      TRUE ~ "❄️ Weak"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_RS3M))

# --- 4. INDUSTRY GROUP MOMENTUM -----------------------------------------------
indgrp <- stocks %>%
  group_by(`Industry Name`) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Rank_Now = mean(`Ind Group Rank`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Rank_3M = mean(`Ind Grp Rnk 3 Mo Ago`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Rank_6M = mean(`Ind Grp Rnk 6 Mo Ago`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_RS = mean(`RS Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_RS3M = mean(`RS 3-Month Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Count >= 3) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_Momentum = Rank_6M - Rank_Now,  # Higher = improving
    Theme_Strength = case_when(
      Rank_Now <= 20 & Rank_Momentum > 30 ~ "🔥 Leading + Improving",
      Rank_Now <= 30 ~ "⚡ Leading",
      Rank_Momentum > 40 ~ "📈 Strongly Improving",
      Rank_Momentum > 20 ~ "🟡 Improving",
      TRUE ~ "➖ Neutral/Declining"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rank_Momentum))

# --- 5. MARKET BREADTH METRICS ------------------------------------------------
breadth <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Above 50SMA", "Above 200SMA", "RS >= 80", "RS Line New High",
               "A/D A or B", "EPS Rating >= 80", "Comp Rating >= 80",
               "Price > All MAs", "Strong Up/Down Vol"),
  Count = c(
    sum(stocks$`Price vs 50-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`Price vs 200-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`RS Rating` >= 80, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`RS Line New High` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`A/D Rating` %in% c("A+","A","A-","B+","B"), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`EPS Rating` >= 80, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`Comp Rating` >= 80, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`Price vs 10-Day` > 0 & stocks$`Price vs 21-Day` > 0 & 
        stocks$`Price vs 50-Day` > 0 & stocks$`Price vs 200-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(stocks$`Up/Down Vol` > 1.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Pct = Count / nrow(stocks) * 100
)

# --- 6. COMPOSITE SCORES ------------------------------------------------------
# CANSLIM Score (0-100)
stocks <- stocks %>%
  mutate(
    C_Score = case_when(
      `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > 100 ~ 25,
      `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > 50  ~ 20,
      `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > 25  ~ 15,
      `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > 10  ~ 10,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ) + case_when(
      `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr` > 50 ~ 10,
      `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr` > 25 ~ 7,
      `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr` > 10 ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    A_Score = case_when(
      `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` > 50 ~ 15,
      `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` > 25 ~ 12,
      `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` > 15 ~ 8,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    N_Score = case_when(
      `RS Line New High` == "Yes" ~ 10,
      `RS Line Within 5% of New High` == "Yes" ~ 7,
      `RS Rating` >= 90 ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    S_Score = case_when(
      `Volume (1000s)` > `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)` * 2 ~ 10,
      `Volume (1000s)` > `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)` * 1.5 ~ 7,
      `Volume (1000s)` > `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)` * 1.2 ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    L_Score = case_when(
      `RS Rating` >= 95 ~ 15,
      `RS Rating` >= 90 ~ 12,
      `RS Rating` >= 85 ~ 10,
      `RS Rating` >= 80 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    I_Score = case_when(
      `Funds %` >= 20 ~ 10,
      `Funds %` >= 10 ~ 7,
      `Funds %` >= 5  ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    M_Score = case_when(
      `Price vs 200-Day` > 20 ~ 10,
      `Price vs 200-Day` > 10 ~ 7,
      `Price vs 200-Day` > 0  ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    CANSLIM_Score = C_Score + A_Score + N_Score + S_Score + L_Score + I_Score + M_Score,

    # Momentum Score
    Momentum_Score = (`RS Rating` + `RS 3-Month Rating` + `Comp Rating`) / 3 +
      case_when(`% Chg 3 Months` > 50 ~ 15, `% Chg 3 Months` > 30 ~ 10, `% Chg 3 Months` > 15 ~ 5, TRUE ~ 0) +
      case_when(`Price vs 50-Day` > 10 ~ 5, `Price vs 50-Day` > 0 ~ 2, TRUE ~ 0),

    # Quality Score (GARP)
    Quality_Score = case_when(
      `ROE` > 25 ~ 20, `ROE` > 15 ~ 15, `ROE` > 10 ~ 10, TRUE ~ 0
    ) + case_when(
      `Debt %` < 20 ~ 15, `Debt %` < 40 ~ 10, `Debt %` < 60 ~ 5, TRUE ~ 0
    ) + case_when(
      `Current Ratio` > 2 ~ 10, `Current Ratio` > 1 ~ 5, TRUE ~ 0
    ) + case_when(
      `EPS Rating` >= 80 ~ 15, `EPS Rating` >= 60 ~ 10, TRUE ~ 0
    ) + case_when(
      `SMR Rating` >= 80 ~ 10, TRUE ~ 0  # Will be 0 if SMR is missing
    ),

    # Earnings Acceleration Flag
    EPS_Accel = `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` & `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > 25,
    Sales_Accel = `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr` > `Avg Sales % Chg 3Q` & `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr` > 20,

    # Setup Classification
    Setup_Type = case_when(
      `Price vs 10-Day` >= -3 & `Price vs 10-Day` <= 2 & 
        `Price vs 21-Day` > 2 & `RS Rating` >= 80 & `% Off High` > -15 & `% Off High` < -1 ~ "Pullback to 10SMA",
      `% Off High` > -5 & `% Off High` < 0 & `RS Rating` >= 85 & 
        `RS Line New High` == "Yes" & `Volume (1000s)` > `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)` * 1.2 ~ "Breakout",
      `10 Day > 21 Day > 50 Day` == "Yes" & `50-Day > 150-Day > 200-Day` == "Yes" &
        `RS Rating` >= 85 & `Comp Rating` >= 85 & `% Chg 3 Months` > 20 ~ "Momentum Leader",
      EPS_Accel & Sales_Accel & `RS Rating` >= 75 & `EPS Rating` >= 75 ~ "Earnings Accelerator",
      CANSLIM_Score >= 60 ~ "CANSLIM Growth",
      `Price vs 200-Day` > 0 & `PEG` > 0 & `PEG` < 1.5 & `P/E` > 0 & `P/E` < 20 & 
        `ROE` > 15 & `RS Rating` >= 60 ~ "Value + Quality",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# --- 7. SCREENED LISTS --------------------------------------------------------

# Top CANSLIM
canslim_top <- stocks %>%
  filter(CANSLIM_Score >= 55, `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  arrange(desc(CANSLIM_Score), desc(`RS Rating`)) %>%
  head(30)

# Top Momentum
momentum_top <- stocks %>%
  filter(Momentum_Score >= 75, `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  arrange(desc(Momentum_Score), desc(`RS Rating`)) %>%
  head(30)

# Earnings Accelerators
accel_top <- stocks %>%
  filter(EPS_Accel, `RS Rating` >= 75, `EPS Rating` >= 70, `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  arrange(desc(`EPS % Chg Last Qtr`), desc(`RS Rating`)) %>%
  head(30)

# Breakout Candidates
breakout_top <- stocks %>%
  filter(`% Off High` > -5, `% Off High` < 0, `RS Rating` >= 85,
         `RS Line New High` == "Yes", `Price vs 50-Day` > 0,
         `Volume (1000s)` > `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)`,
         `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  arrange(desc(`RS Rating`), desc(`Volume (1000s)` / `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)`)) %>%
  head(20)

# Pullback to 10SMA
pb_top <- stocks %>%
  filter(`Price vs 10-Day` >= -3, `Price vs 10-Day` <= 2,
         `Price vs 21-Day` > 0, `Price vs 50-Day` > 0, `Price vs 200-Day` > 0,
         `RS Rating` >= 80, `RS 3-Month Rating` >= 75, `Comp Rating` >= 80,
         `% Off High` > -15, `% Off High` < -1,
         `A/D Rating` %in% c("A+","A","A-","B+","B"),
         `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  arrange(desc(`RS Rating`), desc(`Comp Rating`)) %>%
  head(30)

# Value + Quality
value_top <- stocks %>%
  filter(`P/E` > 0, `P/E` < 25, `PEG` > 0, `PEG` < 2, `ROE` > 15,
         `Debt %` < 60, `RS Rating` >= 60, `Price vs 200-Day` > 0,
         `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  arrange(desc(Quality_Score), desc(`RS Rating`)) %>%
  head(30)

# --- 8. VISUALIZATION 1: SECTOR ROTATION HEATMAP ----------------------------
# --- 8. VISUALIZATION 1: SECTOR ROTATION HEATMAP ----------------------------

sector_order <- sector_perf %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_RS3M)) %>%
  pull(Sector)

plot_sector_heatmap <- sector_perf %>%
  mutate(Sector = factor(Sector, levels = rev(sector_order))) %>%
  select(Sector, Avg_RS3M, Avg_3M, Avg_YTD, Avg_EPS_Q, Pct_Above_200SMA) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sector,
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(
      Metric,
      Avg_RS3M = "RS 3M",
      Avg_3M = "3M Return",
      Avg_YTD = "YTD Return",
      Avg_EPS_Q = "EPS Growth",
      Pct_Above_200SMA = "% > 200SMA"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Sector, fill = Value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",
    mid = "#ffffbf",
    high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sector Rotation Heatmap",
    subtitle = paste("Data as of:", report_date),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# --- 9. VISUALIZATION 2: RS vs MOMENTUM SCATTER -----------------------------
plot_rs_momentum <- stocks %>%
  filter(`Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  mutate(
    Sector_Label = ifelse(Sector %in% c("INSURANCE","BANKS","SOFTWARE","MEDICAL",
                                          "ENERGY","CHIPS","COMPUTER","ELECTRNCS"),
                          Sector, "Other"),
    Size_Bucket = case_when(
      `Market Cap (mil)` > 50000 ~ "Large Cap",
      `Market Cap (mil)` > 10000 ~ "Mid Cap",
      TRUE ~ "Small Cap"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `RS Rating`, y = `% Chg 3 Months`, 
             color = Sector_Label, size = `Market Cap (mil)` / 1000)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 90, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8), name = "Mkt Cap (B)") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-50, 150)) +
  labs(title = "RS Rating vs 3-Month Performance",
       subtitle = "Top-right quadrant = Momentum Leaders | Red lines = RS 80/90 thresholds",
       x = "RS Rating", y = "3-Month % Change") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# --- 10. VISUALIZATION 3: EARNINGS ACCELERATION -----------------------------
plot_earnings_accel <- stocks %>%
  filter(`EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > -100, `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` < 500,
         `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` > -100, `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` < 500,
         `Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  mutate(
    Accel_Flag = `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q` & `EPS % Chg Last Qtr` > 25,
    RS_High = `RS Rating` >= 80
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q`, y = `EPS % Chg Last Qtr`)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Accel_Flag, alpha = RS_High), size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 25, linetype = "dotted", color = "green") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 25, linetype = "dotted", color = "green") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#e41a1c", "FALSE" = "#377eb8"),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "Accelerating", "FALSE" = "Decelerating")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.9, "FALSE" = 0.3),
                     guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, 200), ylim = c(-50, 300)) +
  labs(title = "Earnings Acceleration Map",
       subtitle = "Above diagonal = accelerating vs 3Q avg | Red = accelerating + RS>=80",
       x = "Avg EPS Growth (Last 3Q)", y = "Last Quarter EPS Growth") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

# --- 11. VISUALIZATION 4: MARKET BREADTH DASHBOARD ----------------------------
plot_breadth <- breadth %>%
  mutate(Metric = fct_reorder(Metric, Pct)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Pct, fill = Pct)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Pct)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fc8d59", high = "#91cf60") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Market Breadth Dashboard",
       subtitle = paste("n =", nrow(stocks), "stocks |", report_date),
       x = NULL, y = "% of Universe") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20))

# --- 12. VISUALIZATION 5: INDUSTRY GROUP RANK MOMENTUM ------------------------
plot_indgrp <- indgrp %>%
  head(20) %>%
  mutate(`Industry Name` = fct_reorder(`Industry Name`, Rank_Momentum)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Rank_Momentum, y = `Industry Name`, fill = Rank_Now)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d73027", high = "#1a9850",
                      name = "Current\nRank") +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Industry Groups by Rank Improvement",
       subtitle = "6M Ago Rank minus Current Rank (higher = more improvement)",
       x = "Rank Improvement", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# --- 13. VISUALIZATION 6: RISK/REWARD MATRIX ----------------------------------
plot_risk_reward <- stocks %>%
  filter(`Market Cap (mil)` > 300, !is.na(`% Off High`), !is.na(`RS Rating`)) %>%
  mutate(
    Zone = case_when(
      `RS Rating` >= 80 & `% Off High` > -10 & `% Off High` < 0 ~ "🎯 Sweet Spot",
      `RS Rating` >= 80 & `% Off High` <= -10 ~ "💪 Strong but Deep PB",
      `RS Rating` >= 80 & `% Off High` >= 0 ~ "🔥 Extended",
      `RS Rating` < 60 & `% Off High` > -10 ~ "⚠️ Weak Near Highs",
      TRUE ~ "➖ Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `% Off High`, y = `RS Rating`, color = Zone)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-15, -5, 0), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(60, 80, 90), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "🎯 Sweet Spot" = "#1a9850",
    "💪 Strong but Deep PB" = "#4575b4",
    "🔥 Extended" = "#d73027",
    "⚠️ Weak Near Highs" = "#fc8d59",
    "➖ Other" = "gray70"
  )) +
  labs(title = "Risk / Reward Matrix",
       subtitle = "X-axis: % Off 52W High (closer to 0 = closer to highs) | Y-axis: RS Rating",
       x = "% Off 52-Week High", y = "RS Rating") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# --- 14. VISUALIZATION 7: VOLUME-PRICE ACTION --------------------------------
plot_volume_price <- stocks %>%
  filter(`Market Cap (mil)` > 300, !is.na(`Up/Down Vol`), `Up/Down Vol` < 10) %>%
  mutate(
    Vol_Signal = case_when(
      `Up/Down Vol` > 2 & `Price vs 50-Day` > 5 ~ "🚀 Accumulation + Extension",
      `Up/Down Vol` > 2 & `Price vs 50-Day` < 0 ~ "⚠️ Distribution",
      `Up/Down Vol` > 1.5 & `Price vs 50-Day` > 0 ~ "📈 Accumulation",
      TRUE ~ "➖ Neutral"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Price vs 50-Day`, y = `Up/Down Vol`, color = Vol_Signal)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "🚀 Accumulation + Extension" = "#1a9850",
    "⚠️ Distribution" = "#d73027",
    "📈 Accumulation" = "#4575b4",
    "➖ Neutral" = "gray70"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5)) +
  labs(title = "Volume-Price Action",
       subtitle = "Up/Down Volume Ratio vs Price vs 50-Day SMA",
       x = "Price vs 50-Day SMA (%)", y = "Up/Down Volume Ratio") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# --- 15. VISUALIZATION 8: CANSLIM SCORE DISTRIBUTION --------------------------
plot_canslim_dist <- stocks %>%
  filter(`Market Cap (mil)` > 300) %>%
  mutate(Score_Bucket = cut(CANSLIM_Score, breaks = c(-Inf, 20, 40, 55, 70, Inf),
                            labels = c("Weak (0-20)", "Fair (21-40)", 
                                       "Good (41-55)", "Strong (56-70)", "Elite (71+)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Score_Bucket, fill = Score_Bucket)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlGn") +
  labs(title = "CANSLIM Score Distribution",
       subtitle = paste("n =", nrow(stocks %>% filter(`Market Cap (mil)` > 300))),
       x = "CANSLIM Score Bucket", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --- 16. VISUALIZATION 9: SECTOR PERFORMANCE WATERFALL ------------------------
plot_sector_waterfall <- sector_perf %>%
  select(Sector, Avg_3M, Avg_6M, Avg_YTD, Avg_12M) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sector, names_to = "Period", values_to = "Return") %>%
  mutate(Period = recode(Period,
    "Avg_3M" = "3M",
    "Avg_6M" = "6M",
    "Avg_YTD" = "YTD",
    "Avg_12M" = "12M"
  )) %>%
  filter(Sector %in% (sector_perf %>% head(15) %>% pull(Sector))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = Return, group = Sector, color = Sector)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Sector Performance Trajectory (Top 15 by 3M RS)",
       subtitle = "Track which sectors are accelerating or decelerating",
       x = NULL, y = "Avg Return (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# --- 17. VISUALIZATION 10: TOP SETUPS SUMMARY ---------------------------------
all_setups <- bind_rows(
  canslim_top %>% select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup = Setup_Type, 
                         `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
    mutate(List = "CANSLIM Growth"),
  momentum_top %>% select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup = Setup_Type,
                          `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
    mutate(List = "Momentum Leaders"),
  accel_top %>% select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup = Setup_Type,
                       `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
    mutate(List = "Earnings Accelerators"),
  breakout_top %>% select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup = Setup_Type,
                          `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
    mutate(List = "Breakout Candidates"),
  pb_top %>% select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup = Setup_Type,
                    `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
    mutate(List = "Pullback to 10SMA"),
  value_top %>% select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Setup = Setup_Type,
                       `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
    mutate(List = "Value + Quality")
) %>%
  distinct(Symbol, List, .keep_all = TRUE)

plot_setup_summary <- all_setups %>%
  count(List, Sector) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = List, y = n, fill = Sector)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Setup Distribution by Strategy & Sector",
       subtitle = paste("Total unique setups:", nrow(all_setups)),
       x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# --- 18. COMBINE ALL PLOTS ---------------------------------------------------
# Use patchwork to create a dashboard layout
# Note: In Quarto, you can render individual plots or use patchwork
# For a qmd tab, render them individually or as a combined figure

cat("\n### Visualization Dashboard\n")

# Display plots (in qmd, each ggplot object will render automatically)
plot_sector_heatmap
plot_rs_momentum
plot_earnings_accel
plot_breadth
plot_indgrp
plot_risk_reward
plot_volume_price
plot_canslim_dist
plot_sector_waterfall
plot_setup_summary

# --- 19. OUTPUT TABLES --------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n### Top CANSLIM Growth Stocks\n")
canslim_top %>%
  select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, CANSLIM_Score,
         `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `EPS Rating`, `Current Price`,
         `EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr`, `% Chg 3 Months`, `% Off High`) %>%
  arrange(desc(CANSLIM_Score)) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Top CANSLIM Growth Stocks",
             subtitle = paste("Score >= 55 |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(CANSLIM_Score, `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `EPS Rating`), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr`, `% Chg 3 Months`, `% Off High`), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2) %>%
  data_color(columns = CANSLIM_Score,
             colors = scales::col_numeric(palette = c("#d73027", "#fc8d59", "#fee08b", "#91cf60", "#1a9850"),
                                           domain = c(40, 90)))

cat("\n### Top Momentum Leaders\n")
momentum_top %>%
  select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Momentum_Score,
         `RS Rating`, `RS 3-Month Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`,
         `% Chg 3 Months`, `% Chg 6 Months`, `Price vs 50-Day`, `% Off High`) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Top Momentum Leaders",
             subtitle = paste("Score >= 75 |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Momentum_Score, `RS Rating`, `RS 3-Month Rating`, `Comp Rating`), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`% Chg 3 Months`, `% Chg 6 Months`, `Price vs 50-Day`, `% Off High`), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2)

cat("\n### Earnings Accelerators\n")
accel_top %>%
  select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, `RS Rating`, `EPS Rating`, `Current Price`,
         `EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q`, `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr`, `EPS Est Cur Yr %`, `% Off High`) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Earnings Accelerators",
             subtitle = paste("Last Qtr EPS > 3Q Avg & >25% |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`RS Rating`, `EPS Rating`), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`EPS % Chg Last Qtr`, `Avg EPS % Chg 3Q`, `Sales % Chg Lst Qtr`, 
                         `EPS Est Cur Yr %`, `% Off High`), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2)

cat("\n### Breakout Candidates\n")
breakout_top %>%
  select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, `RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`, `Current Price`,
         `% Off High`, `Volume (1000s)`, `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)`, `RS Line New High`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
  mutate(Vol_Ratio = round(`Volume (1000s)` / `50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)`, 1)) %>%
  select(-`Volume (1000s)`, -`50-Day Avg Vol (1000s)`) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Breakout Candidates",
             subtitle = paste("Within 5% of highs, RS Line New High, Volume Confirm |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`RS Rating`, `Comp Rating`), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`% Off High`, `% Chg 3 Months`, Vol_Ratio), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2)

cat("\n### Pullback to 10SMA Setups\n")
pb_top %>%
  select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, `RS Rating`, `RS 3-Month Rating`, `Comp Rating`,
         `Current Price`, `Price vs 10-Day`, `Price vs 21-Day`, `% Off High`, `% Chg 3 Months`) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Pullback to 10SMA Setups",
             subtitle = paste("High RS, resting at 10SMA after strength |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`RS Rating`, `RS 3-Month Rating`, `Comp Rating`), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`Price vs 10-Day`, `Price vs 21-Day`, `% Off High`, `% Chg 3 Months`), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2)

cat("\n### Value + Quality (GARP)\n")
value_top %>%
  select(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`, Quality_Score, `RS Rating`, `Current Price`,
         `P/E`, `PEG`, `ROE`, `Debt %`, `EPS Rating`, `Price vs 200-Day`) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Value + Quality (GARP)",
             subtitle = paste("Low P/E, Low PEG, High ROE, Low Debt |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Quality_Score, `RS Rating`, `EPS Rating`), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`P/E`, `PEG`, `ROE`, `Debt %`, `Price vs 200-Day`), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = `Current Price`, decimals = 2)

# --- 20. MASTER WATCHLIST (All setups combined) --------------------------------
cat("\n### Master Watchlist (All Setups Combined)\n")
master_watchlist <- all_setups %>%
  group_by(Symbol, Name, Sector, `Industry Name`) %>%
  summarise(
    Lists = paste(unique(List), collapse = ", "),
    Avg_RS = mean(`RS Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Comp = mean(`Comp Rating`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Price = first(`Current Price`),
    Chg_3M = first(`% Chg 3 Months`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_RS), desc(Avg_Comp))

master_watchlist %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Master Watchlist",
             subtitle = paste(nrow(master_watchlist), "unique stocks across all strategies |", report_date)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Avg_RS, Avg_Comp), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = Chg_3M, decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = Price, decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(11))

# --- 21. WEEKLY TRACKING VARIABLES (for time-series analysis) -----------------
# Save key metrics for week-over-week comparison
weekly_snapshot <- tibble(
  Date = report_date,
  Total_Stocks = nrow(stocks),
  Above_50SMA = sum(stocks$`Price vs 50-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  Above_200SMA = sum(stocks$`Price vs 200-Day` > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  RS_80_Plus = sum(stocks$`RS Rating` >= 80, na.rm = TRUE),
  RS_Line_New_High = sum(stocks$`RS Line New High` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
  CANSLIM_Count = nrow(canslim_top),
  Momentum_Count = nrow(momentum_top),
  Breakout_Count = nrow(breakout_top),
  PB_Count = nrow(pb_top),
  Avg_Mkt_RS3M = mean(sector_perf$Avg_RS3M, na.rm = TRUE),
  Top_Sector = sector_perf$Sector[1],
  Top_Sector_RS3M = sector_perf$Avg_RS3M[1]
)

# Append to a running CSV for trend analysis
# write_csv(weekly_snapshot, "data/weekly_snapshots.csv", append = TRUE)

cat("\n### Weekly Snapshot Metrics\n")
weekly_snapshot %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Weekly Market Snapshot",
             subtitle = report_date) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Avg_Mkt_RS3M, Top_Sector_RS3M), decimals = 1)
